nodes.description: Public token symbol string of the JORDAN ERC20 contract.
Public token name string of the JORDAN ERC20 contract.
Public token decimals (18) of the JORDAN ERC20 contract.
Total token supply storage variable _totalSupply, set in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance.
Address of the current contract owner, used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used in the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtracts two uints and requires no underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: divides two uints after requiring a non-zero divisor.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalizes the ownership handover.
JORDAN constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints all tokens.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address): returns the balance of a given token owner.
transfer(address,uint): debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using SafeMath.
approve(address,uint): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without a race check.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and debits the allowance.
allowance(address,address): returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): approves then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts; contract does not accept ETH.
onlyOwner function that forwards an arbitrary ERC20 transfer to the owner.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval interface callback executed by approveAndCall.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during contract deployment.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], the caller-controlled account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed by the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the callback.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
Owned constructor initialises the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the new address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
JORDAN constructor sets the symbol state variable.
JORDAN constructor sets the name state variable.
JORDAN constructor sets the decimals state variable.
JORDAN constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
JORDAN constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of the deployer address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for the sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for the spender before making the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner state variable.
transfer performs an internal call to safeSub for the sender balance.
transfer performs an internal call to safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom performs internal safeSub calls on balance and allowance.
transferFrom performs an internal safeAdd call to credit the recipient.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract, allowing attacker code to re-enter the token after the allowance write.
The user-supplied spender parameter becomes the target of the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract, which can execute attacker code during the owner-only flow.
The tokenAddress parameter is used as the target contract address of the external transfer call.
The 'to' parameter determines the credited account in transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount debited and credited by transfer.
The 'spender' parameter is the key of the allowance written by approve.
The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance value set by approve.
The 'from' parameter is the account debited by transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the account credited by transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer key read by allowance.
The spender parameter is the inner key read by allowance.
The spender parameter receives the approval and is the callback target in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
The _newOwner parameter is staged into newOwner by transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: 'to' is a transient parameter of transfer and only meaningful through that function's balance update.
'tokens' is a transient parameter of transfer and only meaningful through that function's balance update.
'spender' is a transient parameter used only to key the allowance write inside approve.
'tokens' is a transient parameter used only as the allowance value inside approve.
'from' is a transient parameter used only for the debit inside transferFrom.
'to' is a transient parameter used only for the credit inside transferFrom.
'tokens' is a transient parameter used only for the transfer and allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
'tokenOwner' is a transient lookup key in balanceOf.
'tokenOwner' is a transient lookup key in allowance.
'spender' is a transient lookup key in allowance.
'spender' is consumed by approveAndCall as the approval key and callback target, hence folded into that function and its unsafe external call.
'tokens' is consumed only as the approved amount inside approveAndCall.
'data' is consumed only as the payload forwarded by approveAndCall.
'tokenAddress' is consumed only as the external call target inside transferAnyERC20Token.
'tokens' is consumed only as the forwarded amount inside transferAnyERC20Token.
'_newOwner' is consumed only as the staged owner value inside transferOwnership.
